response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development experience and a passion for open-source geospatial projects (e.g., GISCollective), but his background lacks direct experience with C++/Rust in production routing/tiling pipelines or distributed systems at scale. His expertise aligns more with web/mobile stacks and tooling, though his problem-solving approach and geospatial familiarity are promising.
strengths: Extensive geospatial project experience (GISCollective, Green Map) with open-source contributions.
Proven track record in full-stack development and tooling, including performance optimization (e.g., low-latency apps at Sociomantic).
Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on experimentation (e.g., workshops, TDD, functional programming).
concerns: No direct experience with C++/Rust in routing/tiling pipelines or distributed systems for geospatial data.
Primary expertise lies in JavaScript/TypeScript and web/mobile stacks, not the core technologies (C++/Linux) required.
Lack of demonstrated experience with real-time traffic integration or large-scale data pipeline reliability.
